title: Competitive Bingo board view
description: Response of GET /api/plugin/board. A picture of a game, as the server wants it drawn. This is a document, not a model: every string is shown verbatim and the plugin interprets none of it. A game mode the plugin has never heard of is a different arrangement of the same three section kinds, and needs no plugin release. See docs/api-contract.md section 4.5.

title.description: Heading for the window, e.g. the game's name.

subtitle.description: One line under the title, e.g. 'Classic - first line wins'.

capturedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds the server built this at. The plugin shows it, because the board is a snapshot from the last sync and a player needs to know it is not live.

kind.description: GRID lays cells out by their own row and col - a bingo board, but equally a progression ladder or one row of stages. LIST draws them in the order given, one per row. TEXT draws body as a paragraph. A kind the plugin does not recognise is skipped and the rest of the board still draws, so this vocabulary may be added to without waiting for players to update.

title.description: Heading for the section, or null for an unheaded one.

rows.description: GRID only. May be omitted, in which case the plugin takes the extent from the cells themselves. A cell outside the stated size widens the grid rather than being discarded.

cols.description: GRID only, under the same rules as rows.

cell.description: One square of a GRID section, or one row of a LIST section.

row.description: GRID only, zero-based. A cell missing either coordinate is dropped from a grid; a square with no cell is drawn blank. Ignored in a LIST.

title.description: The main line, e.g. 'Dragon pickaxe' or 'The Sharks'.

lines.description: Further lines under the title, e.g. ['3 / 5', 'The Sharks'].

state.description: How the cell is shaded. A state the plugin does not recognise, or null, draws neutral.

accent.description: A colour to key the cell by, as #rrggbb - a team colour, usually. Drawn as a stripe down the edge rather than as a fill, so it never fights the state shading. Anything not matching the pattern is ignored.

tooltip.description: Shown on hover, for detail that will not fit in the cell.
